test-all.template: Run `flutter test` and report any failures

test-file.description: Run a single test file (usage: /test-file path/to/file.dart)
test-file.template: Run `flutter test {{input}}` and report any failures

analyze.template: Run `flutter analyze` and fix any issues found

build-apk.template: Run `flutter build apk --release` and report the result

deploy-rules.template: Run `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` and report the result

deploy-indexes.template: Run `firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes` and report the result
